classification_result: The audit identifies the untwisted downstairs directions whose involutory G60 lifts invert an endpoint order-4 twist lift. These are the reflections realizing the D8 conjugation law inside each non-split D8 x C2 cube preimage.
tested_law: For each lifted cube, select one endpoint order-4 twist lift r. Search the five untwisted downstairs directions for involutory lifts s satisfying s r s^{-1} = r^{-1}.
